Question 5
?

Which of the following is equivalent to ∫Cf(x,y,z)ds, where f(x,y,z)=2x−y2−z2 and the curve C is parametrized by r(t)=⟨t2,t−1,t+1⟩ for t∈[0,3]?

a
−22∫032t2+1dt
b
2∫03(t2−2t)2t2+1dt
c
−2∫03tt2+1dt
d
−2∫03(t2+2t−1)t2+1dt
e
∫03(t2+2t)2t2+1dt
Submit
